nodes.description: Public mapping of user balances in GreenEyedMonsters; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and overwritten arbitrarily in distribute.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount; set to uint(-1) for router and tx.origin in constructor, reduced in transferFrom.
Constant public decimals = 18.
Public total supply (1e30); read in list() to compute owner share.
Token name string 'Green Eyed Monsters'.
Token symbol 'GEM'.
UniswapV2/Pancake router interface instance used for the external addLiquidityETH call in list().
Wrapped ETH address used to derive the pair address in the constructor.
Privileged owner set to tx.origin in the constructor; gate for delegate, distribute and list.
External 'bot protection' contract address invoked via low-level call in the checkBots modifier, distribute and list.
Public pair address derived in the constructor and passed to the bot protection system.
Sets owner = tx.origin, derives uniPair, and grants infinite allowances to the router and tx.origin.
Public payable transfer; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transfer with checkBots modifier; performs unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic (Solidity 0.7 has no overflow checks).
Payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no return-value handling concerns.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into attacker/caller supplied address and calldata.
Pure function computing the CREATE2 pair address from token ordering and init-code hash.
Owner-only loop that overwrites balanceOf entries and emits mint-like Transfer events after a low-level call to the bot protection contract.
Owner-only listing routine: sets balances, calls routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH with block.timestamp deadline, then distributes balances.
Modifier performing a low-level call to protectionFromBots (selector 0x15274141) and requiring the returned notABot flag.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance, ownership checks and transfer routing.
Origin address used to set owner and to grant infinite pair allowance in the constructor.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the router deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list().
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate() that executes external code in the token's storage context.
Low-level .call to the mutable protectionFromBots address; return value of the call itself is not checked.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value with no SafeMath under pragma ^0.7.0 (overflow/underflow possible).
External call to routerForPancake.addLiquidityETH with user-controlled value before state distribution; reentrancy/state-inconsistency risk.
distribute() sets balanceOf[_toWho[i]] = amount, overwriting existing balances and minting without supply accounting.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 computed without SafeMath and assigned to the owner balance in list().
